title: ModelConnection
description: A per-project binding of a provider family to a secret REFERENCE (spec §27.2, E13 T8). Admin-only (the `provision` capability); never model-creatable. The credential itself is never persisted or returned — only the secret_ref handle into the E13 T3 secret store travels here. Since E29 a connection may also carry its OWN endpoint (base_url), which is what makes a custom OpenAI-compatible provider a per-project property rather than a deployment-wide environment variable.

provider.description: The adapter family the broker dials at call time. It must be one the binary can dial — the create refuses any other value rather than storing a connection whose first run dies with unknown_provider.

secret_ref.description: A handle into the E13 T3 secret store; the credential value is redeemed at call time and never appears in any response.

base_url.description: The endpoint this connection dials, for the custom OpenAI-compatible family only — required by it (without one the connection would silently dial the OpenAI API) and refused on families that have an endpoint of their own. Absent means the family's own endpoint. It is vetted through the shared egress policy before it is stored; private and loopback destinations are permitted (a self-hosted deployment's own model server lives there) while metadata, multicast and unspecified addresses are not.

verified_at.description: When the last credential probe ran. Absent means no probe has ever run, which is not a failure: a connection that was never verified routes exactly like one that was.

verification_outcome.description: What the last credential probe OBSERVED. It is a cache of an observation and gates nothing — no dispatch path reads it. `not_probed` means nothing was checked and must never be read as a pass.
